Prepare step by step

  1. For an active roadway emergency, call 911 and move to safety when possible.
  2. Identify the origin, destination, travel window, mobility needs and acceptable alternatives.
  3. Confirm routes, service areas, fares, reservations, accessibility and real-time conditions directly.
  4. Build extra time and a backup option into time-sensitive medical, school, work or court travel.

General transportation planning only—not dispatch, real-time service confirmation, accessibility certification, emergency response or a transportation guarantee.

Before you contact or choose a service.

  • Confirm current requirements, hours, eligibility, credentials, service area, accessibility, availability and total cost directly.
  • Keep names, narratives, account details, medical identifiers, child information and document text off this public page.
  • Directory appearance, order and paid status are not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.
  • You choose whether to copy, print or share this plan; Franklin Navigator does not send it.
